title: λλ: A Programming Language for Silicon Photonics
summary: A research paper presenting λλ, a domain-specific programming language specifically designed for silicon photonics circuit design and programming. The language aims to provide abstractions for specifying optical components, light propagation, and photonic circuit behavior in a type-safe and verifiable manner.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of proper programming abstractions for designing and verifying complex silicon photonic integrated circuits, which currently rely on manual layout and simulation tools.
why_valuable: Enables photonic hardware designers to program optical circuits at a higher abstraction level while ensuring correctness through formal type checking, potentially accelerating photonic chip development.
